value.text: At least 5 years of legal residence in Germany before applying for naturalisation.
value.clock_note: The clock counts years of legal residence in Germany. Check which permits count.

proposals.evidence_snippet: As a general rule, non Germans have the right to become naturalised after five years of legal residence in the Federal Republic of Germany, provided they meet certain additional conditions.
proposals.notes: Federal Foreign Office (Auswaertiges Amt, a German federal ministry) English page 'Law on Nationality'. Value kept identical to the seed. SOURCE URL CORRECTED: the seeded bundesregierung.de/breg-en/news/modernisation-of-citizenship-law-2059392 now redirects to a login page (cvd.bundesregierung.de/cvd-de/login), and bmi.bund.de English pages sit behind a cookie-check that the verifier cannot pass. The Federal Government's own German page https://www.bundesregierung.de/breg-de/aktuelles/kabinett-einbuergerung-2350620 confirms: 'Zukünftig gilt für alle Antragstellenden eine Mindestaufenthaltszeit von fünf Jahren'. Other conditions named on the AA page: sufficient German, naturalisation test, clean record, self-support.

value.text: Germany generally allows dual citizenship since 27 June 2024.

proposals.evidence_snippet: As of 27 June 2024, citizens of all countries who are naturalised in Germany are allowed to hold multiple citizenship.
proposals.notes: Federal Foreign Office English page 'Law on Nationality'. Value kept identical to the seed. SOURCE URL CORRECTED (seeded bundesregierung.de English URL now redirects to a login page). The page adds: 'Applicants must find out in advance whether the laws of their country of origin also permit multiple citizenship.' (Pakistan's side is deliberately left 'Not verified yet' per product owner.)

value.text: The 3-year fast-track route to German citizenship ended in October 2025.

proposals.evidence_snippet: Die bisherige Möglichkeit einer sogenannten „Turboeinbürgerung“ nach 3 Jahren entfällt. Das Gesetz ist am 30. Oktober 2025 in Kraft getreten.
proposals.notes: Official Federal Government page (German; English value is a direct rendering). Page dated Thursday 30 October 2025, title 'Staatsangehörigkeit frühestens nach fünf Jahren'; it also says 'Eine Einbürgerung ist frühestens nach fünf Jahren möglich.' Replaces the seed's news-report basis with an official source; value kept identical to the seed. Supporting official page: Bundestag vote record https://www.bundestag.de/parlament/plenum/abstimmung/abstimmung?id=962 ('Der Bundestag hat am Mittwoch, 8. Oktober 2025, den Gesetzentwurf der Bundesregierung ... verabschiedet'). NOTE: BAMF's English naturalisation page still describes the 3-year route - see the conflicting proposal below and conflicts_noticed.

value.text: Naturalisation is still possible after just 3 years of residence in Germany for applicants with special integration achievements (as stated on BAMF's English naturalisation page).

proposals.evidence_snippet: You have been a habitual and regular resident in Germany for the past five years. If you have demonstrated a special aptitude towards integration – e.g. If you have displayed a particularly good academic or professional performance and possess very good German language skills – naturalisation is possible after just three years of residence in Germany.
proposals.notes: REAL CONFLICT, recorded on purpose. The Federal Office for Migration and Refugees (BAMF) English page 'Naturalisation in Germany', live on 24 Nov 2026, still describes the 3-year route that the Federal Government says was abolished by the law in force since 30 October 2025 (bundesregierung.de proposal above; Bundestag vote 8 October 2025). The BAMF page appears not to have been updated; recommend showing the bundesregierung.de value as primary and this as a stale conflicting source. The BAMF page agrees on the 5-year baseline. Note: Node fetch of bamf.de failed once and succeeded on retry; the ?nn=284310 URL verified FOUND.

value.text: Graduate visa: 2 years if you apply by 31 December 2026; 18 months if you apply from 1 January 2027.
value.clock_note: The length depends on the date you apply for the Graduate visa, not the date you started studying. A Masters starting in 2027 finishes after 1 January 2027, so 18 months is used for ranking.

proposals.evidence_snippet: A Graduate visa lasts for: 2 years if you apply on or before 31 December 2026 18 months if you apply on or after 1 January 2027
proposals.notes: Non-PhD graduates (the page adds 'If you have a PhD or other doctoral qualification, it will last for 3 years.'). Value kept identical to the seed (seed wording 'by'/'from' = page wording 'on or before'/'on or after'). The page also says 'Your visa will start from the day your application is approved.' The clock_note's 2027-intake reasoning is the seed's own inference, not page text.

value.text: The Home Office earned-settlement response of 2 November 2026 raises the starting point for settlement from 5 to 10 years for most migrants.
value.clock_note: Time on the Student and Graduate routes will not count towards the qualifying residence period; only time on routes that lead to settlement (for example a work route) counts. Higher earners can qualify sooner (5 years earning at least £50,271, 3 years at £125,141 or more). The start date has not been published yet.

proposals.notes: Response document 'A Fairer Pathway to Settlement: Government response to the consultation' (CP 1707, November 2026). The consultation page https://www.gov.uk/government/consultations/earned-settlement lists '2 November 2026 Government response added.' and states 'The starting point for settlement will increase from 5 to 10 years.' Basis upgraded from 'inferred' to 'verbatim' because GOV.UK states the 5 -> 10 change verbatim. VALUE TIGHTENED vs the seed: text says 'starting point' (page wording) and the placeholder clock_note is replaced with page facts (companion proposal below backs the Student/Graduate rule; earnings tiers: 'five years for higher earners (earning at least £50,271 ...)' and 'three years for the highest economic contributors (earning at least £125,141 ...)'). The seed value has no evidence, so a reviewer should REPLACE it rather than record a conflict. Transition rules: targeted only - care workers who entered/switched before the May 2025 White Paper keep 5 years if they meet £25,000 salary, sponsorship and employment requirements; below-RQF6 national-pay-scale health/education workers who arrived before May 2025 keep 5 years; pre-April 2024 Skilled Worker cohort can extend on current terms until 2035. 'They do not create a wider exemption for everyone already living in the UK.' Implementation: 'Before implementation, the government will publish further guidance' - no in-force date on the page. sort_months 120 kept (10-year default).

proposals.value: x = 1 + 3 × (Nmax − Nd) / (Nmax − Nmin), where x = equivalent German grade, Nmax = highest grade of the foreign grading system, Nmin = lowest passing grade of the foreign grading system, Nd = grade that shall be converted into the German grading system
proposals.evidence_snippet: Modified Bavarian Formula (MBF) Nmax - Nd x=1+3 --------------- Nmax – Nmin x = equivalent German grade Nmax = highest grade of the foreign grading system Nmin = lowest passing grade of the foreign grading system Nd = grade that shall be converted into the German grading system
proposals.notes: Leuphana University Lueneburg official page; the formula is printed as a text fraction (numerator 'Nmax - Nd' above 'x=1+3 ----', denominator 'Nmax – Nmin'), which the snippet reproduces line by line. Context: this page uses it to convert free-mover study-abroad grades, and rounds to the next German grade (rounding is institution-specific). Same formula in an admissions context: TUM's English application info portal https://www.tum.de/en/studies/application/application-info-portal/grade-conversion-formula-for-grades-earned-outside-germany says 'Converted grades are calculated using the “modified Bavarian formula”, as stipulated by the resolution of the Kultusministerkonferenz' (formula shown only via a calculator, not as text). University of Passau (https://www.geku.uni-passau.de/en/study/examinations/grade-conversion) states 'The highest possible grade and the lowest passing grade are taken from Anabin', supporting the seed's Nmin range caveat. nmax/nmin params unchanged.

conflicts_noticed: de-citizenship-update: two official German federal sources disagree on 24 Nov 2026. bundesregierung.de (https://www.bundesregierung.de/breg-de/aktuelles/kabinett-einbuergerung-2350620) says the 'Turboeinbürgerung' after 3 years is abolished and the law entered into force on 30 October 2025 (Bundestag vote 8 October 2025 on bundestag.de). BAMF's English naturalisation page (https://www.bamf.de/EN/Themen/Integration/ZugewanderteTeilnehmende/Einbuergerung/einbuergerung.html?nn=284310) still says 'naturalisation is possible after just three years of residence in Germany' for special integration achievements. The BAMF page looks outdated; both proposals are included with the same id and field.
